actions.purpose: Exact code sites, file names, caps and the shared interface between the stream writer and the handoff builder
actions.prompt: In /home/dev/Repo/bullswork/bullswarm-handoff (branch handoff, cut from main after v0.32.1; bullswarm routes work across vendor coding-agent CLIs and re-dispatches a failed step on another pool). Context, verified on 2026-09-17: a retry attempt today receives a task file byte-identical to the failed attempt's (observed: run wf-mu4vhjvu-8dd5d4, step stats-pages, attempt 1 on command-code ended 'announcement without substance' after 19 min leaving +1050/-277 unverified lines in src/workflow/stats-view.js; attempt 2 on codex was told nothing). The worker's stream is decoded by src/lib/agent-events.js createAgentEventDecoder from the connector's declarative `eventStream` block (rules, kindPaths, kindMap, summaryPaths; `compact()` clips summaries to 180 chars) and held only in memory: src/lib/watch.js keeps stdout in a BoundedCapture (head+tail, MAX_CAPTURED_STREAM_BYTES) and writes only the final answer to paths.outFile (`writeFileSync(paths.outFile, output)`); events reach the kernel through opts.onAgentEvent / onAgentProgress (src/workflow/v2-dispatch.js ~L214 and L385, src/workflow/v2-runtime.js ~L1057 stores lastAgentEvent). The dispatcher loop in src/workflow/v2-dispatch.js (attempts[], `let nextTask = taskText`, `tried` set, `remaining`, `maxMechanicalRetries`, `retriesUsed`) only ever changes the task text on schema correction via correctionTask() in src/workflow/v2-runtime.js (~L701, appends the validation errors to originalTask). Attempt records are validated on load by src/workflow/v2-state.js: ATTEMPT_FIELDS (~L31) plus noUnknown rejects any unlisted key, so every new attempt field must be added there or runs stop loading (this bit the free-pool branch: `stalled`, `partialOutput`, `silentSec` were added the same way and must stay). The run directory (~/.bullswarm/workflows/<runId>/) holds task-<action>-attempt-N.md, out-<action>-attempt-N.md, workspace-baseline.json (changedFiles at run start, from src/workflow/workspace-report.js `git status -z`), events.jsonl, state.json. Connector manifests live in src/providers/*/connector.json and providers/contrib/*/connector.json, schema in src/providers/_schema.json (`eventStream` is optional; echo has none), validated by `bullswarm providers validate`. tests/agent-events.test.js already holds one real line shape per vendor (codex item.*, claude-code assistant/tool_use, grok text/tool_call, command-code event.*, opencode2 part.*). tests/fixtures/stalling-connector.mjs prints one line then sleeps; tests/fixtures/answering-connector.mjs answers and writes an evidence envelope when the task names a candidate path. Read the goal in docs/plans/handoff.goal.txt and map, with file:line citations you verified by reading, exactly where each part lands: (A) the stream sink — where watch.js can call a per-attempt sink for each decoded event and for raw stdout when there is no eventStream, the bounded-file design (head+tail cap in bytes, the marker line, fsync/append strategy that survives a SIGKILL of the worker and of the kernel), and how the full response text reaches the sink when compact() has already clipped it for the pane (keep the pane path unchanged); (B) the manifest `eventStream.capture` block: fields, defaults, where `providers validate` checks it; (C) the handoff builder — a pure function `handoffBlock(prior, facts) -> string` in v2-runtime.js beside correctionTask(), the exact template text, and where the dispatcher calls it (every re-dispatch of the same action after a not-ok verdict except the schema-correction path), plus the snapshot: `git diff --stat` (and the name list) filtered to the action's ownedFiles taken in the dispatcher the moment the worker exits, saved as diff-<actionId>-attempt-N.txt; (D) every new attempt field and event field with its ATTEMPT_FIELDS entry, the `outputFile`-on-failure fix, `action show` and `watch` rendering; (E) tests to write and the fixture run command; (F) risks: bounded memory, a worker that writes megabytes of response, a connector that emits no `response` kind, ownedFiles empty (integration/evidence steps: diff the whole tree), Windows-free path assumptions. Split the work into two territories that do not collide — stream+manifest (src/lib/agent-events.js, src/lib/watch.js, src/providers/_schema.json, their tests) and dispatcher+state+render (src/workflow/*, tests/workflow-*) — and name the one interface between them (the sink's file path and the response-text accessor) so both writers can build against your report. Read-only: change nothing. Others share this tree: preserve their edits and report any file you need outside your territory instead of editing it. Real data only: read every field name, path and cap from the code; never invent numbers. Do not commit.
